newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Riada stockbrokers announce senior appointments.
newsitem.headline: Riada stockbrokers announce senior appointments.

text.p: Riada stockbrokers said on Thursday that it has appointed John Hogan executive director of Riada Corporate Finance.
Hogan will take responsibility for the development and marketing of corporate advisory services, Riada said in a statement.
Riada's industrial analyst, John Clarke, will take over Hogan's previous role as head of research.
Former Riada employee Eamon Hughes, who is currently working with NCB stockbrokers, will rejoin Riada to become financial sector analyst, the statement said.
Riada is part of the ABN AMRO group.
